Consequently a typed solve endpoint preserving this exact input domain cannot be expressed, including the endpoint required by every source-facet guarantee. This report retains the missing-sort diagnostic without asserting impossibility or acceptance.","attempted_representations":["Declare fill as String and use equality tests in conditional expressions. This computes the two requested behaviors but admits additional strings in the declared input domain; branch guards do not refine the field's type.","Declare fill as String and include its two-value restriction in A1. Although the intended valid observations remain available, the declared D1 domain is still broadened; a predicate cannot supply the missing exact field sort.","Encode fill as Bool, Unit alternatives in Result, or an Option or record. These total operations can preserve clipping, duplicates, nulls, zero sums and causal filling, but their endpoint still requires the unsupported exact fill sort.","Attach all seven source requirements to the aggregation endpoint.
